'''Umgul''' was a mist-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was [[Umgul City]]. The planet's climate was humid and cool, while dense fog and deep hanging clouds were almost omnipresent. Though it was once a conquest of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the planet's natural resources were of no relevance and it was of little strategical importance. Nevertheless, the planet was famous throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a center for [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and sports attractions, most notably the Umgullian [[Blob racing|Blob Racing]].

[[File:Blob.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An Umgullian blob]]
Gambling was considered so important on the planet that cheating was punished by [[Death/Legends|death]]. Cheating was a persistent problem at the races and it had even been suggested by the Umgullian Racing Commission that punishment by death was too lenient.

In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] received information from an anonymous informant about a storehouse on Umgul that was full of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]], such as partially-constructed weapons and devices, as well as copies of [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Murk Lundi]]'s [[The Lundi Series|texts]] and teachings and a drawing of a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] on one of the storehouse's walls.<ref name="Followers">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref>

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] came to Umgul in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] to find a possible candidate for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi academy]]. The lead, Tymmo, nicknamed [[Dack]], was rumored to have predictive abilities due to his successes at gambling. However, Lando, with the help of R2-D2, discovered that he was cheating and exposed him. Rather than be punished by death, as was the law on Umgul, Dack was returned to the Duchess [[Mistal]]. In return, Lando was rewarded with one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Umgul in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Sluis sector is actually located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
